description: Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Thinking is a causal language model trained on 15T tokens that supports only thinking mode with an ultra-long native context length of 262,144 tokens. It utilizes hybrid attention and high-sparsity mixture-of-experts architecture to achieve superior performance in complex reasoning tasks while maintaining parameter efficiency. The model outperforms previous Qwen versions and proprietary models like Gemini-2.5-Flash-Thinking on benchmarks such as MMLU-Pro, AIME25, and coding evaluations.
name: Qwen: Qwen3 Next 80B A3B Thinking
